subject.title: Bug: sandbox.mode: "non-main" silently breaks sessions_spawn subagent initialization

question: Should sandboxed subagent startup failures stay on the accepted async path with a terminal startup-failure state, or should `sessions_spawn` preflight sandbox startup before returning accepted?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the user-visible hang, but the choice affects the public accepted response contract, lifecycle events, registry/session state, gateway wait behavior, and overlap with the broader startup-silence work.

options.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
options.body: Keep the accepted async contract and add typed/logged startup failure state that `subagents list`, session history, and gateway waits can observe.

options.title: Preflight Before Accept
options.body: Validate enough sandbox startup before returning accepted, trading lower ambiguity for new latency and compatibility risk in callers.

options.title: Defer To Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Make the broader lifecycle issue own the event contract, while keeping this issue as the required Docker-backed proof case.

recommendation.title: Terminalize Async Startup Failure
recommendation.body: Keep the accepted async contract and add typed/logged startup failure state that `subagents list`, session history, and gateway waits can observe.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history across sessions_spawn sandbox inheritance, subagent registry lifecycle, and terminal outcome paths.
